FN-LEO9YW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 196
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 196 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Professional Bail
Bonding Board until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
